nodes.source_text: The data set consists of 496 entries... covering the elemental composition in percent representing different (Ni-Fe-Co)Ox materials and characterizing their overpotential (OPs) using a 10 s chronopotentiometry measurement at 10 mA/cm² in O₂ saturated 1.0 M NaOH(aq)

nodes.characterization_summary: Overpotentials (OPs) for 496 (Ni-Fe-Co)Ox catalysts spanning the full Ni_xCo_yFe_z composition space (x+y+z=100%) measured by 10 s chronopotentiometry at 10 mA/cm² in O₂-saturated 1.0 M NaOH(aq).
